segments.text: GOd, the Protector of all that truſte in thee, withoute whome nothing is ſtrong, nothyng is holye: increaſe and multiply vpon vs thy mercy, that thou being our ruler and guide, we may ſo paſſe through thinges temporal, that we finally looſe not the thynges eternall: Graunt this heauenly father, for Ieſu Chriſtes ſake our Lorde.
